description: Compare 2 to 4 vehicles side by side: MPG or MPGe, range, and the yearly fuel cost at current national average prices for your miles, with how much more each costs per year and over 5 years than the cheapest. Each vehicle is a year, make and model (best match) or a fueleconomy.gov id.

city_percent.description: Share of city driving in percent. Default 55 (the EPA assumption).

miles_per_year.description: Miles driven a year. Default 15,000 (the EPA assumption).

id.description: fueleconomy.gov vehicle id instead of make and model (from fuel_economy_models).

name: fuel_economy_compare
title: Compare fuel economy
